name: Light — Reflection & Refraction
description: Explore mirrors, lenses, and total internal reflection.

name: Marine Engineering
description: Explore the physics of locks, buoyancy, and marine fluid systems.

name: Two-Pointer Technique
description: Master algorithmic patterns using two markers to process arrays and strings efficiently.

name: Work, Energy & Power
description: Explore the conservation of energy, roller coasters, springs, and hydroelectric power.

name: Gravitation
description: Explore orbits, Kepler's laws, escape velocity, and satellite missions.

name: ESP32 & Microcontroller Prototyping
description: Wire DevKits with jumpers, check pin rules, run simulations, and generate Arduino sketches.

name: Current Electricity
description: Measure emf, internal resistance and resistance with Ohm's law, the meter bridge and the potentiometer.

name: Waves and Sound
description: Explore stretched strings, resonance and the frequency of tuning forks in a 3D sonometer.

name: Semiconductor Electronics
description: Study p-n junction diodes, their forward and reverse characteristics, and other semiconductor devices.

name: Volumetric Analysis
description: Titrations: find the strength of an acid or alkali from burette readings, using a standard solution and an indicator.

name: Qualitative Analysis
description: Salt analysis and tests for functional groups: identify ions and compounds from what you observe.

name: Ecology
description: Study organisms and populations in the field: sampling with quadrats, density, frequency and abundance.

name: Human Physiology
description: Experiments on how the body works: enzymes, digestion and other physiological processes.

name: Cell Biology
description: Cells under the microscope: preparing slides, stages of cell division and the mitotic index.

name: Genetics
description: Principles of inheritance: Mendel’s laws, Punnett squares and ratios from crosses.

name: Reproduction in Plants
description: Pollen, pollination and fertilisation in flowering plants, studied in the lab.

name: Biotechnology
description: Working with DNA: isolation, and the principles behind recombinant DNA technology.
